domain_description: Aerodynamics, propulsion, structural analysis, avionics, flight controls, maintenance planning, safety management, space systems, composite materials, and airworthiness certification for aircraft and spacecraft per FAA, EASA, NASA, and military standards.
authority_sources: DO-254 (Design Assurance for Airborne Electronic Hardware)
SAE ARP4754A (Development of Civil Aircraft and Systems)

engines.name: Aerodynamics Engine
engines.function: Analyze aerodynamic performance including lift, drag, stability, and control characteristics using panel methods, CFD correlation, and flight test data for fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft.
doctrine_topics: lift and drag coefficient prediction methods
boundary layer analysis and transition prediction
wing design optimization (aspect ratio, taper, sweep)
high-lift device analysis (flaps, slats, leading edge devices)
vortex dynamics and induced drag reduction (winglets)
wind tunnel to flight test correlation

golden_queries.question: Analyze the aerodynamic performance of a transport category aircraft wing at Mach 0.82 cruise, evaluating shock wave formation, wave drag rise, and the effectiveness of supercritical airfoil sections in delay of drag divergence
Calculate the takeoff field length for a twin-engine transport aircraft at maximum takeoff weight with one engine inoperative, per 14 CFR Part 25

engines.name: Propulsion Engine
engines.function: Analyze aircraft propulsion systems including turbofan, turboprop, turboshaft, and electric propulsion with thermodynamic cycle analysis, performance matching, and emissions assessment.
doctrine_topics: turbofan engine performance and bypass ratio optimization
specific fuel consumption and thrust-specific optimization
engine health monitoring and trend analysis

golden_queries.question: Analyze the performance of a high-bypass turbofan engine at design point (35,000 ft, Mach 0.82) and off-design conditions (sea level static, hot day takeoff), calculating thrust, SFC, and component efficiencies

engines.name: Structural Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze aircraft structural integrity including damage tolerance, fatigue evaluation, and static strength assessment per FAR Part 25 and AC 25.571 for metallic and composite structures.
doctrine_topics: aircraft static strength analysis (limit and ultimate loads)
crack growth analysis using Paris law
wing box structural design and analysis
landing gear structural loads and fatigue
bird strike and foreign object damage resistance

golden_queries.question: Perform a damage tolerance assessment for a pressurized fuselage skin panel with a detected 1.5-inch crack at a rivet row, per AC 25.571, determining inspection interval and residual strength

engines.name: Avionics Engine
engines.function: Analyze avionics systems including flight management, communication, navigation, surveillance, displays, and data bus architectures per DO-178C, DO-254, and ARINC standards.
doctrine_topics: flight management system (FMS) architecture and function
ARINC 429 and ARINC 664 data bus protocols
navigation systems (IRS, GPS, VOR, ILS, RNAV, RNP)

golden_queries.question: Design the avionics architecture for a Part 25 transport aircraft upgrade from federated to IMA architecture, addressing DO-178C DAL assignments, ARINC 664 network design, and system safety assessment per ARP4754A

engines.name: Flight Controls Engine
engines.function: Analyze flight control systems including fly-by-wire, mechanical, and autopilot systems with stability augmentation, control law design, and handling qualities assessment per MIL-STD-1797.
doctrine_topics: fly-by-wire flight control architecture and redundancy
control law design for stability augmentation
autopilot mode logic and engagement criteria
control surface sizing and hinge moment analysis
degraded mode operation and manual reversion

golden_queries.question: Analyze the flight control architecture of a quadruple-redundant fly-by-wire system for a transport aircraft, including dissimilar redundancy strategy, control law modes, and degradation logic from normal to direct law

engines.name: Maintenance Planning Engine
engines.function: Develop and optimize aircraft maintenance programs using MSG-3 analysis, reliability-centered maintenance, and condition monitoring per ATA iSpec 2200 and regulatory requirements.
doctrine_topics: maintenance steering group analysis for systems and structures
reliability program and alert service bulletin management
maintenance check packaging (A, B, C, D checks)
ATA chapter system for maintenance documentation

golden_queries.question: Develop an MSG-3 based maintenance program for a new transport aircraft wing structure, including system/component analysis, structural inspection program, and zonal inspection requirements

engines.name: Safety Management Engine
engines.function: Implement aviation safety management systems (SMS) including hazard identification, risk assessment, safety assurance, and safety promotion per ICAO Annex 19 and FAA Order 8000.369.
doctrine_topics: safety management system (SMS) framework per ICAO Annex 19
hazard identification and risk assessment methodology
safety risk matrix and risk tolerance criteria
fault tree analysis and failure probability
common cause failure and common mode analysis

golden_queries.question: Conduct a system safety assessment per ARP4761 for a new engine indication and crew alerting system (EICAS), including functional hazard assessment, fault tree analysis, and failure condition classification
required_elements: failure condition classification (catastrophic, hazardous, major, minor)

engines.name: Space Systems Engine
engines.function: Analyze space systems including orbital mechanics, spacecraft design, launch vehicle performance, thermal control, and mission planning per NASA and ESA standards.
doctrine_topics: launch vehicle performance and payload capacity
spacecraft power system sizing (solar, battery, RTG)

golden_queries.question: Design a LEO Earth observation satellite at 550 km altitude, sizing the power system, thermal control, and communication link for a 5-year mission life with eclipse and sunlight thermal cycling considerations

engines.name: Composite Materials Engine
engines.function: Analyze aerospace composite structures including laminate design, failure prediction, damage assessment, and repair per MIL-HDBK-17/CMH-17 and FAA advisory circulars.
doctrine_topics: classical lamination theory and laminate design
composite structural repair methods and procedures

golden_queries.question: Design a quasi-isotropic carbon/epoxy laminate for an aircraft control surface skin panel subject to combined tension and shear loads, using Tsai-Wu failure criterion and accounting for environmental knockdown factors per CMH-17

engines.name: Certification Engine
engines.function: Guide aircraft and systems certification per 14 CFR Part 25, EASA CS-25, and international validation, including type certificate application, compliance demonstration, and certification planning.
doctrine_topics: type certificate application and certification basis
means of compliance selection (analysis, test, inspection)
special conditions and equivalent safety findings
continued operational safety and airworthiness directives

golden_queries.question: Develop a certification plan for a major modification to a Part 25 transport aircraft involving new winglet installation, including certification basis determination, applicable paragraphs, means of compliance, and flight test requirements
